 "rationale": "A 2nd-order Butterworth gives only about 40 dB at 10·fc, and SK feedthrough through the 1/gm output impedance would eat that margin. Third order gives about 60 dB ideally, and the output RC also filters the feedthrough. Butterworth means no peaking. One OTA: tail of about 45 uA plus IREF, roughly 100 uW. gm of about 400 uS gives a GBW of 25-40 MHz, which is more than 20x f0·Q. The input common mode of 0.9 V suits an NMOS pair, with a tail VDS of about 0.2 V."}

PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (18.0, 10.0, 22.0),     # input pair gm/Id (weak/moderate inversion for gm per uA)
    "L1":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),        # input pair L
    "itail": (45e-6, 25e-6, 62e-6),  # OTA tail current
    "C2":    (1.0e-12, 0.5e-12, 3e-12),   # SK grounded cap
    "qsk":   (0.98, 0.85, 1.1),      # biquad Q (Butterworth-3 -> 1.0, trimmed for finite GBW)
    "R3":    (50e3, 20e3, 150e3),    # output RC pole resistor
    "kf":    (1.0, 0.85, 1.2),       # frequency trim (scales all caps)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 1e-12)
    fc = 1.5e6
    wc = 2 * PI * fc * p["kf"]

    # ---------- current budget ----------
    imax = 140e-6 / vdd * 0.92 - iref
    itail = min(p["itail"], imax)
    i1 = itail / 2

    # ---------- OTA sizing (5T, NMOS input, PMOS mirror) ----------
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], i1, vds=0.45, vsb=0.22)
    m3 = lut.size("p", 10, 1.0, i1, vds=m1.vgs if False else 0.95)   # mirror, |vds| ~ |vgs|
    m3d = lut.size("p", 10, 1.0, i1, vds=0.9)                         # output side
    mb = lut.size("n", 12, 1.0, iref, vds=0.6)                        # bias diode
    mt = lut.size("n", 12, 1.0, itail, vds=0.22)                      # tail (same gm/Id, L)

    # ---------- passives: SK biquad (unity gain, equal R) ----------
    Q = p["qsk"]
    C2 = p["C2"] / p["kf"] * 1.0
    C2 = p["C2"]
    C1 = 4 * Q * Q * C2
    R = 1.0 / (wc * 2 * Q * C2)
    C2_place = max(C2 - 0.5 * m1.cgg, 0.1e-15)      # in+ gate cap adds to C2 (partly bootstrapped)

    # output RC pole at fc; CL is part of it
    R3 = p["R3"]
    Ct = 1.0 / (wc * R3)
    C3 = max(Ct - cl, 0.1e-15)
    Ct = C3 + cl

    # ---------- netlist ----------
    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.R("R1", "vin", "nx", R)
    n.R("R2", "nx", "ny", R)
    n.C("C1", "nx", "vo1", C1)
    n.C("C2", "ny", "vss", C2_place)
    # OTA: in+ = ny, in- = vo1 (unity feedback), out = vo1
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("M1", "nd1", "ny", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "vo1", "vo1", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "nd1", "nd1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "vo1", "nd1", "vdd", "vdd", m3d)
    # output pole
    n.R("R3", "vo1", "vout", R3)
    n.C("C3", "vout", "vss", C3)

    # ---------- analytic prediction (nodal solve incl. OTA gm, Go, Co) ----------
    gm = m1.gm
    Go = m1.gds + m3d.gds
    Co = m1.cdd + m3d.cdd
    Cy = C2_place + 0.5 * m1.cgg
    f = np.logspace(3, 8, 3000)
    mag = np.zeros_like(f)
    G = 1.0 / R; G3 = 1.0 / R3
    for k, fk in enumerate(f):
        s = 1j * 2 * PI * fk
        A = np.array([
            [-2 * G - s * C1, G, s * C1, 0],
            [G, -G - s * Cy, 0, 0],
            [s * C1, gm, -gm - Go - s * Co - s * C1 - G3, G3],
            [0, 0, G3, -G3 - s * Ct]], dtype=complex)
        b = np.array([-G * 1.0, 0, 0, 0], dtype=complex)
        v = np.linalg.solve(A, b)
        mag[k] = 20 * np.log10(abs(v[3]) + 1e-30)
    g0 = mag[0]
    idx = np.where(mag < g0 - 3.0)[0]
    if len(idx):
        i = idx[0]
        x0, x1 = np.log10(f[i - 1]), np.log10(f[i])
        y0, y1 = mag[i - 1], mag[i]
        fc_p = 10 ** (x0 + (g0 - 3.0 - y0) * (x1 - x0) / (y1 - y0))
    else:
        fc_p = f[-1]
    peak = max(float(np.max(mag) - g0), 0.0)
    fs = 10 * fc_p
    att = g0 - float(np.interp(np.log10(fs), np.log10(f), mag))
    power = vdd * (iref + itail)
    gbw = gm / (2 * PI * (C1 * Cy / (C1 + Cy) + Co))

    return n, {"gain_db": float(g0), "fc": float(fc_p), "atten_db": float(att),
               "peaking_db": peak, "power": power, "gbw": gbw}
